snippet.title: Scramble Knights Online | First Look
snippet.description:
Sign up for the Beta playtest!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379350/Scramble_Knights_Royale/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=betaoffical&utm_medium=web
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs

Adventure with friends in this multiplayer adventure RPG! Explore a massive online world, conquer dungeons, earn loot, then return home to upgrade your equipment before venturing back out again.

https://www.scrambleknights.com

Follow on X: https://x.com/scrambleroyale
Follow on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/funktronic.bsky.social
Follow on Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@scramble.knights
Join us on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/scrambleknights/
